events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: The iconic Rolling Stones frontman, Sir Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday today, having captivated audiences for over six decades.

angles.name: Jagger's Enduring Energy
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still moving like Jagger! Wishing a very happy birthday to the legendary frontman, Sir Mick Jagger. What's your favourite Stones track that still gets you dancing?

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) first launched in the US on this day in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' famously being the first music video ever aired.

angles.name: MTV's Impact
angles.copy: 45 years since MTV first hit screens, changing music forever! From 'Video Killed The Radio Star' to iconic countdowns, what was your go-to music video from the early days?

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, which quickly became the fastest-selling debut album in British history.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. Which track from their iconic debut still sounds as fresh today as it did in '94?

events.title: Woodstock Festival's 57th anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, attracting over 400,000 people to a dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: Peace, music, and a whole lot of mud! It's 57 years since the iconic Woodstock Festival. What's your favourite performance from that legendary weekend?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of the 'King of Rock and Roll,' Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977, leaving an unparalleled legacy in music.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, on the anniversary of his passing. His music continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tribute to Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, rap icon Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, tragically passing away six days later on September 13.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur on music and culture. His lyrical genius continues to resonate decades on. What's his most iconic track for you?

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix on the anniversary of his passing. His revolutionary guitar work changed music forever. What's your go-to Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road,' was released in the UK on September 26, 1969, featuring iconic tracks and one of music's most famous album covers.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road' – an album and a cover that defined an era. What's your favourite track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde's Birthday Rock
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman is still rocking. What's your favourite track from her iconic career?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The outspoken and iconic former Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: LG's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid's another year older! Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem he fronted?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo single 'Imagine' was released in the US on October 11, 1971, becoming a global anthem for peace and hope.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine', a song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace. What does this iconic track mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music and paving the way for digital music players.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? It's 25 years since Apple launched the original iPod, changing music consumption forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No,' in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 007 first hit the big screen. Which Bond film or theme song is your absolute favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today. The Beatles legend and peace activist was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the timeless artistry and powerful message of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer, John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unparalleled. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' was released in the UK on November 22, 1968, showcasing the band's diverse musical directions.

angles.name: White Album Diversity
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles released 'The White Album', a sprawling masterpiece that showed their incredible range. Which track from the double album is your unexpected favourite?
